主要内容: On December 13, 2012, Standard & Poor’s Rating Agency announced that it has changed the rating outlook for Royal Bank of Canada from “negative” to “stable.” This update is incorporated by reference into the Registration Statements on Form F-3 and S-8. The change reflects a shift in the credit rating outlook, indicating a more favorable assessment of the bank's financial position and risk profile. The update is part of the supplementary disclosure provided in the registrant’s Annual Report on Form 40-F dated November 29, 2012. The change in rating outlook may influence investor perceptions and market sentiment regarding the bank's creditworthiness and financial stability. The update is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada, on January 7, 2013. This information is relevant for understanding the bank's financial standing and its implications for investors and stakeholders in the banking industry.
